import * as T from 'three';
export const CHANGCHUN_WEST_REGION=Object.freeze({minX:152,maxX:163.5,minZ:373,maxZ:386});
export const CHANGCHUN_WEST_ANCHOR=Object.freeze([[159.19,.6,382.85].map(Math.fround),[162.89,1.1,385.55].map(Math.fround)]);
export function validateChangchunWestScope(input,box,region){const[lo,hi]=CHANGCHUN_WEST_ANCHOR;if(input.id!=='changchun-west-interior'||input.groundY!==undefined||Object.keys(CHANGCHUN_WEST_REGION).some(k=>region[k]!==CHANGCHUN_WEST_REGION[k])||box.min.toArray().some((v,i)=>v!==lo[i])||box.max.toArray().some((v,i)=>v!==hi[i]))throw new TypeError('Changchun west requires exact preserved kang source and bounded interior domain');}
// Unique inherited hall platform support, not a new slab or implicit ground.
// Its original .6 support datum (versus rendered paving) is retained unchanged.
export function registeredChangchunWestFloor(source,scope,x,z,radius){if(scope.kind!=='changchun-west-interior'||scope.id!=='changchun-west-interior'||![x,z,radius].every(Number.isFinite)||radius<=0||radius>.5||Object.keys(CHANGCHUN_WEST_REGION).some(k=>scope[k]!==CHANGCHUN_WEST_REGION[k])||x+radius+.25<scope.minX||x-radius-.25>scope.maxX||z+radius+.25<scope.minZ||z-radius-.25>scope.maxZ)return null;const lo=[150.2-(27.1+1.6)/2,.6,379.6-(13.8+1.6)/2],hi=[150.2+(27.1+1.6)/2,.6,379.6+(13.8+1.6)/2],owners=source.walkables?.filter(w=>w.type==='box'&&w.box.min.toArray().every((v,i)=>v===lo[i])&&w.box.max.toArray().every((v,i)=>v===hi[i]))??[];if(owners.length!==1||x-radius<lo[0]||x+radius>hi[0]||z-radius<lo[2]||z+radius>hi[2])return null;return{height:.6,owner:owners[0],source:'existing-changchun-west-floor',regionId:scope.id,witness:new T.Vector3(x,.6,z)};}
